description: Japanese/English language switch (i18n) for the frontend (requirement #5). Add a lightweight in-repo i18n layer (React context + a translation dictionary, NO heavy new dependency) with a JA/EN toggle in the header. Localize ALL user-facing UI strings: app title/subtitle, season selector label, loading/error/empty/offline-notice statuses, bracket legend + round names, series statuses, the standings panel, the prediction panel, the game-detail toggle and detail page, and the team-name display including a localized fallback for unknown/preview team ids. Persist the chosen language in localStorage (nice-to-have but include it).
steps: Create a lightweight i18n layer under frontend/src/i18n/ (e.g. i18n/index.ts with a Lang type 'ja'|'en', a nested or flat message dictionary for both languages, an I18nProvider React context, a useI18n() hook returning { lang, setLang, t } where t(key, params?) does lookup + simple interpolation (e.g. {season}), and a localized roundName()/statusLabel()/teamName() helper). Default language: pick a sensible default (e.g. 'ja' per the user's own Japanese request, or detect navigator.language with 'en' fallback) and document the choice. Persist lang to localStorage (key e.g. 'mlb.lang') and hydrate from it on load; guard localStorage access for SSR/jsdom safety. Do NOT add a new npm dependency - justify the lightweight approach in a code comment and in the spec/README (FEAT-005 handles docs).
Wrap the app in I18nProvider in frontend/src/main.tsx (inside the Router from FEAT-003).

Add a language toggle control in the header (frontend/src/App.tsx) - a JA/EN segmented button group (role=group, aria-pressed on the active language, accessible label). Clicking switches language live and persists it.

Localize App.tsx strings: app title (keep brand name but localize the subtitle 'YYYY postseason bracket, standings, and AI predictions/final results'), the season selector label 'Season', loading ('Loading the YYYY postseason...'), error, the 'has not started yet' message, the offline 'bundled offline data' notice, 'Final results' treatment text, and the footer.

Localize bracketLayout/round names and series statuses: provide localized ROUND names (Wild Card/Division Series/Championship Series/World Series) and STATUS labels (scheduled/in_progress/final) via the i18n helpers. Update BracketView.tsx legend (American League / World Series / National League) and the round-title headings, and SeriesCard.tsx round + STATUS_LABEL + 'Best of N' meta + the game-detail toggle labels ('Show games'/'Hide games') + the predict/detail affordance labels to use t().

Localize StandingsPanel.tsx (title, league group titles, progress text) and PredictionPanel.tsx (title 'AI Prediction', hints, 'Generating prediction...', error, 'Favorite', 'Win probability', 'over <team>', 'Model:' label) and the SeriesDetailPage (title, back link, per-game labels) from FEAT-003 via t().

Team-name display + unknown/preview fallback: centralize team-name resolution so SeriesCard, PredictionPanel, StandingsPanel, and the detail page all use ONE helper. Known teams: show TEAMS[id].name (optionally allow a localized name map later, but English club names are acceptable in both languages - document that). Unknown/preview ids (not in TEAMS - the real 2026 live-data case the screenshot showed as 'Team 5513'): render a LOCALIZED placeholder instead of raw 'Team <id>', e.g. EN 'TBD (#<id>)' and JA '未定 (#<id>)' (choose clear wording; the point is to not leak 'Team 5513'). Apply the same fallback in abbreviation spots (game score lines) sensibly.

Add/extend tests: unit test the i18n layer (t() lookup + interpolation, roundName/statusLabel/teamName fallback for a known id and an unknown id in both languages, localStorage persistence round-trip). Add a Playwright e2e that toggles JA/EN and asserts a representative visible string changes language (e.g. the season label or a round name), that the choice persists across a reload, and that an unknown team id renders the localized placeholder rather than 'Team <id>'. Update existing e2e selectors if they matched now-localized text (prefer role/testid/aria selectors over brittle text where the text is now localized; keep the default-language assertions consistent with the chosen default).
Run frontend build + unit tests + e2e to confirm green.
acceptance_criteria: A JA/EN language toggle in the header switches ALL user-facing UI strings live (title/subtitle, season label, statuses, round names, legend, standings, prediction panel, toggle labels, detail page) and the active language is indicated accessibly (aria-pressed).
The language choice persists across a page reload (localStorage), verified by an e2e test.
Unknown/preview team ids render a localized placeholder (e.g. EN 'TBD (#id)' / JA '未定 (#id)') instead of the raw 'Team <id>' string, verified by a test, in both languages.
Round names and series statuses are localized in both languages.
No new runtime npm dependency is added for i18n (lightweight in-repo layer).
PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build, npm test -w @mlb/frontend, and npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend all pass.
findings:
DONE and green: `npm run build` (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra), `npm test` (shared 14, backend 57, frontend 34 [was 20], infra 6), `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` (16 Playwright tests [was 14]), and `npm run synth` all pass. NO new runtime dependency added (lightweight in-repo React context). FEAT-005 MUST build on these exact facts.

I18N LAYER LOCATION + API:
- frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts: exports `type Lang = 'ja'|'en'`, `LANGS` (['ja','en']), the FLAT dictionary `MESSAGES: Record<Lang, Record<MessageKey,string>>` keyed by dotted string-literal `MessageKey`s (NOT nested), `ROUND_KEY: Record<RoundName,MessageKey>`, and `STATUS_KEY: Record<Series['status'],MessageKey>`.
- frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: the public API. Hook `useI18n(): { lang, setLang, t }`. `t: TFn = (key: MessageKey, params?: Record<string,string|number>) => string` does dictionary lookup + `{param}` interpolation (missing key falls back to the key itself; missing param leaves `{name}` intact). Exports helpers `roundName(t, round)`, `statusLabel(t, status)`, `teamName(t, teamId)`, `teamAbbr(t, teamId)` and the primitives `createTranslator(lang)`, `interpolate(tpl, params)`, `readStoredLang()`. Also exports `I18nProvider` (prop `initialLang?: Lang` used by unit tests to pin a language), `DEFAULT_LANG`, `LANG_STORAGE_KEY`, `LANGS`, and types `TFn`/`Lang`/`MessageKey`.

HOW TO ADD A KEY (for FEAT-005's accuracy UI): add the key to the `MessageKey` union in messages.ts AND to BOTH the `en` and `ja` records in `MESSAGES` (TypeScript enforces exhaustiveness, so a missing language entry fails the build). Then call `t('your.key', {param})` in the component. Non-component code can use `createTranslator(lang)`.

DEFAULT LANGUAGE: 'ja' (DEFAULT_LANG). Chosen because the site's feature requests arrived in Japanese. On load the provider hydrates from localStorage (if a valid 'ja'/'en' is stored) else falls back to DEFAULT_LANG. localStorage KEY: 'mlb.lang' (LANG_STORAGE_KEY). All localStorage access is try/catch-guarded for jsdom/SSR safety; an invalid stored value is ignored.

PROVIDER WIRING: frontend/src/main.tsx wraps <App/> in <I18nProvider> INSIDE <BrowserRouter>. The header JA/EN toggle is frontend/src/components/LanguageToggle.tsx: a role=group (aria-label from t('app.lang.group')) with two buttons, aria-pressed on the active lang, label '日本語'/'English'; clicking calls setLang (live re-render + persist). Rendered in HomePage.tsx header.

TEAM-NAME RESOLUTION CENTRALIZED: all four panels (SeriesCard, PredictionPanel, StandingsPanel, SeriesDetailPage) now call the SHARED `teamName(t, id)` / `teamAbbr(t, id)` from i18n (their local `Team ${id}` helpers were deleted). Known teams render TEAMS[id].name (English club names in BOTH languages - documented in messages.ts; MLB club names are commonly English even on JA sites). UNKNOWN/preview ids (not in TEAMS, e.g. the real 2026 'Team 5513' case) render the LOCALIZED placeholder from key 'team.unknown': EN exactly 'TBD (#<id>)' (e.g. 'TBD (#5513)'), JA exactly '未定 (#<id>)' (e.g. '未定 (#5513)'). teamAbbr uses the SAME placeholder for unknown ids on game score lines so no raw numeric id leaks.

LOCALIZED ROUND/STATUS: round keys round.wildCard/divisionSeries/championshipSeries/worldSeries; status keys status.scheduled/in_progress/final. EN keeps the canonical English; JA: ワイルドカード/地区シリーズ/リーグ優勝決定シリーズ/ワールドシリーズ and 開始前/進行中/終了.

E2E SELECTOR CHANGES (important for FEAT-005 when it adds the accuracy control + final=>no-predict messaging): because the DEFAULT language is Japanese, text-based selectors that matched English now match Japanese OR were switched to structural selectors:
- Added data-testid="season-group" to the season <div role=group> in HomePage; e2e now uses page.getByTestId('season-group') instead of getByRole('group',{name:/season/i}).
- Predict button / detail link / games toggle are matched by CLASS (.series-card__predict, .series-card__detail-link, .series-card__games-toggle) rather than by (now-localized) label.
- Region/heading/text assertions updated to the Japanese defaults: bracket region /トーナメント表/, prediction region /勝敗予測/, final-results region /最終結果/, offline notice /オフラインの収録データ/, round headings ワイルドカード etc., legend alt アメリカンリーグ/ナショナルリーグ/ワールドシリーズ, series meta '試合制', games toggle 試合を表示/試合を隠す, detail game labels 第N戦, detail result /シリーズを/, prediction error prefix /予測を読み込めませんでした/, not-found region /シリーズが見つかりません/.
- Club names (e.g. 'Los Angeles Dodgers', 'Houston Astros') stay ENGLISH in both languages, so those assertions were left as-is.
- New fixture: frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET now also contains an UNKNOWN-team Division Series (SAMPLE_2026_UNKNOWN_SERIES_ID='2026-nl-division-5513-5599', SAMPLE_2026_UNKNOWN_TEAM_ID=5513) to exercise the placeholder. New spec frontend/e2e/i18n.spec.ts: toggles JA/EN (season label + round heading flip), asserts persistence across reload, and asserts the unknown id shows '未定 (#5513)'/'TBD (#5513)' never 'Team 5513'.
- Unit tests: new frontend/src/i18n/index.test.ts (t lookup+interpolation, round/status/team helpers for known+unknown ids in BOTH langs, localStorage round-trip) and frontend/src/components/LanguageToggle.test.tsx. Existing App/SeriesCard/PredictionPanel tests now wrap renders in <I18nProvider initialLang="en"> so their English assertions remain valid.

NOT DONE HERE (left for FEAT-005): the accuracy UI control, the fuller final=>no-predict messaging, and spec/README updates. FEAT-005 must localize any new strings via the same t()/key workflow and keep the JA-default e2e selectors above in mind.
